items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the compatibility of flat pullback with the cap by a first Chern class at source lines 2802-2813, label lemma-flat-pullback-cap-c1, whose proof occupies source lines 2815-2856. The proof reduces a general cycle to the class of a single integral closed subspace and then works on its preimage under the flat morphism, where the flat pullback of that class becomes a sum over the irreducible components of the fibre weighted by their multiplicities. The meromorphic section used to describe the Chern class is restricted to those components and the prepare version of the formula identifies the two cycles on the preimage, after which the two sides of the statement are recognised as the pushforwards of those cycles. The counted statement records neither the reduction to a single subspace nor the decomposition of the pullback with multiplicities.
